translations.literal: When Yan marched east, Inspector of Yu Ma Xianbi held troops and would not join Yan; Yan sent his old acquaintance Yao Zhongbin to persuade him; Xianbi first set out wine for him, then executed him at the army gate as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: When Yan marched east, Inspector of Yu Ma Xianbi held his army and would not join him. Yan sent his old friend Yao Zhongbin to persuade him; Xianbi set out wine, then executed Zhongbin at the army gate as a warning.

sentences.zh: 衍又遣其族叔懷遠說之，仙玭曰：「大義滅親。

translations.literal: Yan again sent his clansman-uncle Huaiyuan to persuade him; Xianbi said, "Righteousness overrides kinship."
translations.idiomatic: Yan sent his clansman-uncle Huaiyuan; Xianbi said, "Righteousness overrides kinship."

sentences.zh: 」又欲斬之；

translations.literal: " He wished to execute him as well;
translations.idiomatic: " He meant to execute him too;

sentences.zh: 軍中為請，乃得免。

translations.literal: The army pleaded on his behalf, and he was spared.
translations.idiomatic: the army pleaded, and Huaiyuan was spared.

sentences.zh: 衍至新林，仙玭猶於江西日抄運船。

translations.literal: When Yan reached Xinlin, Xianbi was still daily plundering transport boats west of the river.
translations.idiomatic: When Yan reached Xinlin, Xianbi was still daily seizing transport boats west of the river.

sentences.zh: 衍圍宮城，州郡皆遣使請降，吳興太守袁昂獨拒境不受命。

translations.literal: Yan besieged the palace-city; provinces and commanderies all sent envoys to surrender; only Wuxing Administrator Yuan Ang held his borders shut and would not accept orders.
translations.idiomatic: Yan besieged the palace-city; provinces and commanderies sent envoys to surrender; only Wuxing Administrator Yuan Ang shut his borders and refused orders.

sentences.zh: 昂，顗之子也。

translations.literal: Ang was Yan's son.
translations.idiomatic: Ang was the son of Yan.

sentences.zh: 衍使駕部郎考城江革為書與昂曰：「根本既傾，枝葉安附？

translations.literal: Yan sent Director of the Imperial Carriage Office Jiang Ge of Kaocheng to write Ang: "The root has already toppled—where can the branches attach?"
translations.idiomatic: Yan had Jiang Ge of Kaocheng, Director of the Imperial Carriage Office, write to Ang: "The root has toppled—where can the branches cling?"

sentences.zh: 今竭力昏主，未足為忠；

translations.literal: To strain now for a benighted lord is not enough to count as loyalty;
translations.idiomatic: To exhaust yourself for a benighted lord is not loyalty;

sentences.zh: 家門屠滅，非所謂孝。

translations.literal: your clan slaughtered to extinction is not what is called filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: to see your house slaughtered is not filial piety.

sentences.zh: 豈若翻然改圖，自招多福！

translations.literal: How is it not better to turn your plan about at once and invite much blessing for yourself!"
translations.idiomatic: Why not turn at once and win blessing for yourself!"

sentences.zh: 」昂復書曰：「三吳內地，非用兵之所；

translations.literal: " Ang replied: "The Three Wu are inner lands, not a place for deploying troops;
translations.idiomatic: " Ang replied: "The Three Wu are heartland, not a field for armies;

sentences.zh: 況以偏隅一郡，何能為役！

translations.literal: how much less can a single commandery in a remote corner serve as a tool of war!"
translations.idiomatic: and what can one remote commandery do!"

sentences.zh: 自承麾旆屆止，莫不膝袒軍門。

translations.literal: Since your banners and staffs arrived, none have failed to bare their knees at the army gate.
translations.idiomatic: Since your banners arrived, all have bared their knees at the army gate.

sentences.zh: 惟僕一人敢後至者，政以內揆庸素，文武無施，雖欲獻心，不增大師之勇；

translations.literal: Only I alone dared to come late, truly because inwardly I measure my mediocrity and plainness, with nothing to offer in civil or martial affairs; though I wished to offer my heart, I would not increase the Grand Marshal's courage;
translations.idiomatic: Only I dared lag behind, for I know my mediocrity—nothing to offer in civil or martial arts. Though I wished to give my heart, I would not add to the Grand Marshal's strength;

sentences.zh: 置其愚默，寧沮眾軍之威。

translations.literal: to set aside my dull silence would rather damp the awe of the mass of armies.
translations.idiomatic: and my silence would only damp the army's spirit.

sentences.zh: 幸藉將軍含弘之大，可得從容以禮。

translations.literal: Fortunately relying on the general's great forbearance, I may be treated with leisurely courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: By your forbearance, I may yet be met with courtesy.

sentences.zh: 竊以一餐微施，敞昨投殞；

translations.literal: I venture that for one meal's slight favor, Zang Zuo cast away his life yesterday;
translations.idiomatic: One meal's kindness made Zang Zuo give his life yesterday;

sentences.zh: 況食人之祿而頓忘一旦，非惟物議不可，亦恐明公鄙之，所以躊躇，未遑薦璧。

translations.literal: how much more for eating another's salary to forget it in a single morning—not only would public opinion not allow it, I also fear Your Excellency would despise it; therefore I hesitate and have not yet offered the jade disc of surrender.
translations.idiomatic: how much more for one who ate another's salary to forget it in a day—not only would the world condemn me, I fear you would despise me. That is why I hesitate and have not yet offered the jade of surrender.

sentences.zh: 昂問時事於武康令北地傅映，映曰：「昔元嘉之末，開闢未有，故太尉殺身以明節。

translations.literal: Ang asked Fu Ying, Magistrate of Wukang from Beidi, about current affairs; Ying said, "In the closing years of Yuanjia, when restoration had not yet come, therefore the Grand Commandant gave his life to clarify integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Ang asked Fu Ying, Magistrate of Wukang from Beidi, about the times. Ying said, "At the end of Yuanjia, when restoration had not yet dawned, the Grand Commandant gave his life to show his integrity.

sentences.zh: 司徒當寄托之重，理無苟全，所以不顧夷險以循名義。

translations.literal: The Grand Mentor bore the weight of entrustment; reason allowed no easy survival—hence he paid no heed to peril or ease in following fame and duty.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Mentor bore the weight of the realm; he could not seek safety alone, and so faced peril and ease alike to keep faith with duty.

sentences.zh: 今嗣主昏虐，曾無悛改；

translations.literal: Now the heir-lord is brutal and benighted, with never a thought of reform;
translations.idiomatic: Today's heir is brutal and benighted, without a thought of reform;

sentences.zh: 荊、雍協舉，乘據上流，天人之意可知。

translations.literal: Jing and Yong rise together, holding the upper stream; the intent of Heaven and men can be known.
translations.idiomatic: Jing and Yong rise together and hold the upper Yangzi; the intent of Heaven and men is plain.

sentences.zh: 願明府深慮，無取後悔。

translations.literal: I beg the governor to ponder deeply and not bring regret upon himself.
translations.idiomatic: I beg you, sir, to ponder this deeply and not bring regret upon yourself.

sentences.zh: 」及建康平，衍使豫州刺史李元履巡撫東士，敕元履曰：「袁昂道素之門，世有忠節，天下須共容之，勿以兵威陵辱。

translations.literal: " When Jiankang was pacified, Yan sent Governor of Yuzhou Li Yuanyi to tour and comfort the eastern lands, instructing Yuanyi: "Yuan Ang's house is one of moral integrity; for generations it has shown loyal integrity. The realm must make room for him—do not insult him with military force."
translations.idiomatic: When Jiankang was pacified, Yan sent Li Yuanyi, Governor of Yu Province, to tour and comfort the eastern lands, instructing him, "Yuan Ang comes from a house of moral integrity and has shown loyal integrity for generations. The realm must make room for him—do not insult him with military force."

sentences.zh: 」元履至吳興，宜衍旨；

translations.literal: " When Yuanyi reached Wuxing he proclaimed Yan's intent;
translations.idiomatic: When Yuanyi reached Wuxing he proclaimed Yan's intent;

sentences.zh: 昂亦不請降，開門撤備而已。

translations.literal: Ang also did not ask to surrender—he only opened the gates and removed defenses.
translations.idiomatic: Ang also did not formally surrender—he only opened the gates and removed his defenses.

sentences.zh: 仙玭聞台城不守，號泣謂將士曰：「我受人任寄，義不容降，君等皆有父母，我之忠臣，君為孝子，不亦可乎！

translations.literal: When Xianbi heard the Terrace City could not be held, he wept aloud and told his officers and men: "I have received another's trust; by duty I cannot surrender. You all have parents—let me be the loyal minister and you be filial sons; is that not fitting!"
translations.idiomatic: When Xianbi heard the Terrace City had fallen, he wept aloud and told his officers and men, "I have received another's trust; by duty I cannot surrender. You all have parents—let me be the loyal minister and you be filial sons. Is that not fitting?"

sentences.zh: 」乃悉遣城內兵出降，餘壯士數十，閉門獨守。

translations.literal: " He then sent all troops within the city out to surrender; several dozen stalwart men remained, shut the gates, and held alone.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent all troops within the city out to surrender. Several dozen stalwart men remained, shut the gates, and held alone.

sentences.zh: 俄而兵入，圍之數十重。

translations.literal: Before long troops entered and surrounded them in dozens of rings.
translations.idiomatic: Before long troops entered and surrounded them in dozens of rings.

sentences.zh: 仙玭令士皆持滿，兵不敢近。

translations.literal: Xianbi ordered his men all to draw to the full; the soldiers did not dare approach.
translations.idiomatic: Xianbi ordered his men to draw their bows full; the soldiers did not dare approach.

sentences.zh: 日暮，仙玭乃投弓曰：「諸君但來見取，我義不降！

translations.literal: At day's end Xianbi cast down his bow and said: "Gentlemen, come and take me—I will not surrender on principle!"
translations.idiomatic: At day's end Xianbi cast down his bow and said, "Gentlemen, come and take me—I will not surrender on principle!"

sentences.zh: 」乃檻送石間。

translations.literal: " He was then sent in a cage to Shijian.
translations.idiomatic: He was then sent in a cage to Shijian.

sentences.zh: 衍釋之，使待袁昂至俱入，曰：「令天下見二義士。

translations.literal: Yan released him and had him wait until Yuan Ang arrived to enter together, saying: "Let the realm see two men of principle."
translations.idiomatic: Yan released him and had him wait until Yuan Ang arrived to enter together, saying, "Let the realm see two men of principle."

sentences.zh: 」衍謂仙玭曰：「射鉤、斬祛、昔人所美。

translations.literal: " Yan said to Xianbi: "Shooting the hook and cutting the sleeve—men of old praised such things."
translations.idiomatic: Yan said to Xianbi, "Shooting the hook and cutting the sleeve—men of old praised such things."

sentences.zh: 卿勿以殺使斷運自嫌。

translations.literal: "Do not reproach yourself for killing an envoy and cutting off your fortune."
translations.idiomatic: "Do not reproach yourself for killing an envoy and cutting off your fortune."

sentences.zh: 」仙玭謝曰：「小人如失主犬，後主飼之，則復為用矣。

translations.literal: " Xianbi thanked him and said: "A petty man is like a dog that has lost its master—if a later master feeds him, he will serve again."
translations.idiomatic: Xianbi thanked him and said, "A petty man is like a dog that has lost its master—if a later master feeds him, he will serve again."

sentences.zh: 」衍笑，皆厚遇之。

translations.literal: " Yan laughed and treated them both generously.
translations.idiomatic: Yan laughed and treated them both generously.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，蕭衍入鎮殿中。

translations.literal: On bingxu Xiao Yan entered and took up residence in the central hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Xiao Yan entered and took up residence in the central hall.

sentences.zh: 劉希祖既克安成，移檄湘部，始興內史王僧粲應之。

translations.literal: After Liu Xizu had taken Ancheng he issued a proclamation to the Xiang region; Shixing Interior Minister Wang Sencan responded.
translations.idiomatic: After Liu Xizu had taken Ancheng he issued a proclamation to the Xiang region. Shixing interior minister Wang Sencan responded.

sentences.zh: 僧粲自稱湘州刺史，引兵襲長沙。

translations.literal: Sencan styled himself Governor of Xiangzhou and led troops to strike Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: Sencan styled himself Governor of Xiang Province and led troops to strike Changsha.

sentences.zh: 去城百餘里，於是湘州郡縣兵皆蜂起以應僧粲，唯臨湘、湘陰、瀏陽、羅四縣尚全。

translations.literal: A hundred-odd li from the city, thereupon troops of Xiangzhou's commanderies and districts all swarmed up to answer Sencan; only Linxiang, Xiangyin, Liuyang, and Luo four districts still held intact.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred-odd li from the city, troops of Xiang Province's commanderies and districts all swarmed up to answer Sencan. Only the four districts of Linxiang, Xiangyin, Liuyang, and Luo still held intact.

sentences.zh: 長沙人皆欲泛舟走，行事劉坦翻聚其舟焚之，遣軍主尹法略拒僧粲，戰數不利。

translations.literal: The people of Changsha all wished to flee by boat; Acting Administrator Liu Tan instead gathered the boats and burned them, sent army commander Yin Falüe to resist Sencan, and fought several times without success.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Changsha all wished to flee by boat. Acting Administrator Liu Tan instead gathered the boats and burned them, sent army commander Yin Falüe to resist Sencan, and fought several times without success.

sentences.zh: 前湘州鎮軍鐘玄紹潛結士民數百人，刻日悉城應僧粲。

translations.literal: Former Xiangzhou Garrison General Zhong Xuanshao secretly joined several hundred gentry and commoners, setting a date for the whole city to respond to Sencan.
translations.idiomatic: Former Xiang Province garrison general Zhong Xuanshao secretly joined several hundred gentry and commoners, setting a date for the whole city to respond to Sencan.

sentences.zh: 坦聞其謀，陽為不知，因理訟至夜，而城門遂不閉，以疑之。

translations.literal: Tan heard of the plot but pretended ignorance; he held court on lawsuits until night while the city gates were left unclosed, to sow doubt.
translations.idiomatic: Tan heard of the plot but pretended ignorance. He held court on lawsuits until night while the city gates were left unclosed, to sow doubt.

sentences.zh: 玄紹未發，旦，詣坦問其故，坦久留與語，密遣親兵收其家書。

translations.literal: Before Xuanshao acted, at dawn he came to Tan to ask the reason; Tan detained him long in talk and secretly sent trusted soldiers to seize the papers at his home.
translations.idiomatic: Before Xuanshao acted, at dawn he came to Tan to ask the reason. Tan detained him long in talk and secretly sent trusted soldiers to seize the papers at his home.

sentences.zh: 玄紹在坐，而收兵巳報，具得其文書本末。

translations.literal: Xuanshao was still seated when the soldiers sent to seize returned with report, obtaining the full record of his documents.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanshao was still seated when the soldiers sent to seize returned with report, obtaining the full record of his documents.

sentences.zh: 玄紹即首伏，於坐斬之；

translations.literal: Xuanshao at once confessed with bowed head and was beheaded on the spot;
translations.idiomatic: Xuanshao at once confessed with bowed head and was beheaded on the spot;

sentences.zh: 焚其文書，餘黨悉無所問。

translations.literal: his documents were burned and the rest of the faction were not questioned.
translations.idiomatic: his documents were burned and the rest of the faction were not questioned.

sentences.zh: 眾愧且服，州郡遂安。

translations.literal: The masses were ashamed yet convinced, and the province and districts were thereby pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The masses were ashamed yet convinced, and the province and districts were thereby pacified.

sentences.zh: 法略與僧粲相持累月，建康城平，楊公則還州，僧粲等散走。

translations.literal: Falüe and Sencan faced one another for months; when Jiankang was pacified Yang Gongze returned to the province and Sencan and the others scattered and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Falüe and Sencan faced one another for months. When Jiankang was pacified Yang Gongze returned to the province and Sencan and the others scattered and fled.

sentences.zh: 王丹為郡人所殺，劉希祖亦舉郡降。

translations.literal: Wang Dan was killed by men of his commandery; Liu Xizu also raised the commandery in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Dan was killed by men of his commandery. Liu Xizu also raised the commandery in surrender.

sentences.zh: 公則克己廉賦，輕刑薄賦。

translations.literal: Gongze restrained himself, was frugal in levies, light in punishments, and thin in taxes.
translations.idiomatic: Gongze restrained himself, was frugal in levies, light in punishments, and thin in taxes.

sentences.zh: 頃之，湘州戶口幾復其舊。

translations.literal: Before long Xiangzhou's registered population nearly returned to its former level.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Xiang Province's registered population nearly returned to its former level.

translations.idiomatic: Category: Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance
